<style>
.sim-console{--bezel1:#1a1f1b;--bezel2:#0d110e;--panel:#0a150e;--panel2:#0c1c12;--edge:#2f6b3f;--edge2:#1d4227;--ink:#8ee39a;--ink-dim:#4f8f5e;--ink-bright:#c9ffd4;--amber:#e0b83a;--red:#e0554a;--blue:#58a6ff;--grn:#6fe08a;--band-l:#6fb6ff;--band-m:#e6d152;--band-s:#6fe08a;--lock-ring:15px;box-sizing:border-box;display:flex;flex-direction:column;width:100%;height:100%;max-height:100%;overflow:hidden;padding:6px;background:radial-gradient(120% 90% at 50% 0%,#171c18 0%,#090c0a 70%);font-family:"DejaVu Sans Mono","Roboto Mono",Consolas,monospace;color:var(--ink);font-size:11px;line-height:1.25;letter-spacing:.02em;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
.sim-console *{box-sizing:border-box}
.sim-console .bezel{flex:1;min-height:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;padding:5px;border:2px solid #242a25;border-radius:7px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--bezel1),var(--bezel2));box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #000,inset 0 2px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.8);overflow:hidden}
.sim-console .screen{flex:1;min-height:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;padding:5px;border:1px solid var(--edge);border-radius:3px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#08120c,#050a07 60%,#07100b);box-shadow:inset 0 0 50px rgba(20,120,50,.10),inset 0 0 0 1px #0c2413;overflow:hidden}

.sim-console .topbar{flex:0 0 auto;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(180px,1fr) auto minmax(160px,auto);gap:8px;align-items:center;border:1px solid var(--edge2);background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0d1d12,#091209);padding:1px 8px;border-radius:2px;overflow:hidden}
.sim-console .brand{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0;min-width:0}
.sim-console [data-slot="system-name"]{height:19px;min-width:160px;display:block;font-size:15px;letter-spacing:.10em;color:var(--ink-bright);text-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(110,230,140,.35);overflow:hidden}
.sim-console .brand .sub{font-size:8.5px;color:var(--ink-dim);letter-spacing:.13em;text-transform:uppercase;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.sim-console .statechips{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;flex-wrap:nowrap;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden}
.sim-console .chip{border:1px solid var(--edge2);padding:1px 6px;font-size:8.5px;letter-spacing:.10em;color:var(--ink-dim);background:#08130c;border-radius:2px;text-transform:uppercase;white-space:nowrap}
.sim-console .chip.on{color:var(--ink-bright);border-color:var(--edge);background:#0f2a18;box-shadow:inset 0 0 10px rgba(80,200,110,.18)}
.sim-console .clockwrap{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-end;gap:0}
.sim-console .clockwrap .lab{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.15em;color:var(--ink-dim)}
.sim-console [data-slot="clock"]{height:22px;min-width:150px;display:block;padding:0 6px;border:1px solid var(--edge);background:#061009;font-size:15px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--amber);text-align:right;text-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(224,184,58,.3);overflow:hidden}

/* ANCHORED LAYOUT: side columns are fixed px, the scope takes every remaining pixel.
   Injected content (interception messages, long track lists) can never widen a column
   or grow a row, so the radar port keeps its size. */
.sim-console .main{flex:1 1 auto;min-height:0;display:grid;gap:4px;overflow:hidden;grid-template-columns:66px minmax(0,1fr) 262px 132px;grid-template-rows:minmax(0,1fr);grid-template-areas:"rail scope picture res"}
.sim-console .rail{grid-area:rail;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;min-width:0;min-height:0;overflow:hidden}
.sim-console .scope{grid-area:scope;min-width:0;min-height:0;overflow:hidden}
.sim-console .picture{grid-area:picture;min-width:0;min-height:0;overflow:hidden}
.sim-console .right{grid-area:res;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;min-width:0;min-height:0;overflow:hidden}

.sim-console .panel{display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:0;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--edge2);border-radius:2px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--panel2),var(--panel));box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
.sim-console .panel>.hd{flex:0 0 auto;display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;gap:6px;padding:1px 6px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--edge2);background:linear-gradient(180deg,#123321,#0b1e12);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-bright);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden}
.sim-console .panel>.hd .r{font-size:7.5px;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--ink-dim);text-transform:none;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.sim-console .panel>.bd{flex:1 1 auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:0;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;padding:3px}
.sim-console .scope>.bd{padding:2px}

.sim-console .kv{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:4px;font-size:7.5px;padding:0;border-bottom:1px dotted #14351f}
.sim-console .kv:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.sim-console .kv b{color:var(--ink-bright);font-weight:500;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;white-space:nowrap}
.sim-console .kv span{color:var(--ink-dim)}
.sim-console .kv.warn b{color:var(--amber)}
.sim-console .grouplab{font-size:7px;letter-spacing:.10em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-dim);margin:3px 0 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--edge2)}
.sim-console .grouplab:first-child{margin-top:0}

/* range / scale control strip \u2014 live control is rendered into the slot */
.sim-console .rangebar{flex:0 0 auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;height:18px;padding:0 1px 1px;margin-bottom:1px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--edge2);font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.10em;color:var(--ink-dim);text-transform:uppercase;overflow:hidden}
.sim-console .rangebar .zlab{white-space:nowrap}
.sim-console [data-slot="range"]{flex:1 1 auto;display:block;min-width:0;height:16px;overflow:hidden}

.sim-console .scopewrap{position:relative;flex:1 1 auto;display:flex;align-items:stretch;justify-content:center;min-height:0;min-width:0;padding:0;overflow:hidden;background:radial-gradient(72% 72% at 50% 92%,rgba(15,61,31,.55) 0%,rgba(4,10,6,.15) 100%)}
.sim-console [data-slot="scope"]{position:absolute;inset:0;display:block;min-height:0;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;cursor:grab;touch-action:none;overscroll-behavior:contain;-webkit-user-select:none;user-select:none}
.sim-console [data-slot="scope"]:active{cursor:grabbing}
.sim-console [data-slot="scope"] *{touch-action:none}
.sim-console [data-slot="scope"] svg{width:100%;height:100%;display:block}
/* lock-on / selection marker: tight ring hugging the track symbol only */
.sim-console [data-slot="scope"] .lock-ring,.sim-console [data-slot="scope"] .sel-ring,.sim-console [data-slot="scope"] circle.lock,.sim-console [data-slot="scope"] circle.selected{r:9px;fill:none;stroke:var(--amber);stroke-width:1.2;stroke-dasharray:3 3}
.sim-console [data-slot="scope"] div.lock-ring,.sim-console [data-slot="scope"] div.sel-ring{width:var(--lock-ring);height:var(--lock-ring);margin:calc(var(--lock-ring) / -2) 0 0 calc(var(--lock-ring) / -2);border:1px dashed var(--amber);border-radius:50%;background:none}
.sim-console .scopefoot{flex:0 0 auto;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:0 6px;height:12px;padding-top:1px;border-top:1px solid var(--edge2);font-size:8px;color:var(--ink-dim);letter-spacing:.04em;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden}

/* TRACK READOUT: the injected table owns its own header row. Columns are sized for every
   profile field plus the IFF code the runtime reports for each track; nothing here may
   hide, collapse or clip that column. */
.sim-console [data-slot="tracks"]{flex:1 1 auto;display:block;min-height:0;min-width:0;padding:1px;overflow:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;font-size:8px;line-height:1.12;background:repeating-linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(30,90,50,.07) 0 16px,transparent 16px 32px)}
.sim-console [data-slot="tracks"] table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;table-layout:auto;font-size:8px}
.sim-console [data-slot="tracks"] th,.sim-console [data-slot="tracks"] td{padding:1px 2px;white-space:nowrap;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;text-align:left;overflow:visible;text-overflow:clip}
.sim-console [data-slot="tracks"] th{font-size:6.5px;letter-spacing:.03em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-dim);border-bottom:1px solid var(--edge2);position:sticky;top:0;background:#0b1e12;z-index:1}
/* IFF code cell: force it visible whatever markup the runtime uses, and never let it be
   the column that gets squeezed away. Empty IFF reads as a dash, not as blank space. */
.sim-console [data-slot="tracks"] .iff,.sim-console [data-slot="tracks"] .iff-code,.sim-console [data-slot="tracks"] .col-iff,.sim-console [data-slot="tracks"] [data-field="iff"],.sim-console [data-slot="tracks"] [data-col="iff"],.sim-console [data-slot="tracks"] [data-key="iff"],.sim-console [data-slot="tracks"] [headers~="iff"]{display:table-cell!important;visibility:visible!important;width:auto!important;max-width:none!important;color:var(--ink-bright);letter-spacing:.03em}
.sim-console [data-slot="tracks"] th.iff,.sim-console [data-slot="tracks"] th[data-field="iff"],.sim-console [data-slot="tracks"] th[data-col="iff"]{display:table-cell!important;color:var(--ink-dim)}
.sim-console [data-slot="tracks"] td:empty::after{content:"\2013";color:var(--ink-dim)}

.sim-console [data-slot="resources"]{flex:1 1 auto;display:block;min-height:0;min-width:0;padding:1px;overflow:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;font-size:8px;line-height:1.12}
.sim-console [data-slot="resources"] *{font-size:inherit;line-height:inherit}
/* interceptor bands are colour-keyed: long = blue, medium = yellow, short = green.
   These are readouts, not controls \u2014 the tone follows whatever the runtime labels a row. */
.sim-console [data-slot="resources"] [class*="long" i],.sim-console [data-slot="resources"] [data-band*="long" i],.sim-console [data-slot="resources"] [data-type*="long" i]{color:var(--band-l);border-left:2px solid var(--band-l);padding-left:3px}
.sim-console [data-slot="resources"] [class*="medium" i],.sim-console [data-slot="resources"] [class*="mid" i],.sim-console [data-slot="resources"] [data-band*="med" i],.sim-console [data-slot="resources"] [data-type*="med" i]{color:var(--band-m);border-left:2px solid var(--band-m);padding-left:3px}
.sim-console [data-slot="resources"] [class*="short" i],.sim-console [data-slot="resources"] [data-band*="short" i],.sim-console [data-slot="resources"] [data-type*="short" i]{color:var(--band-s);border-left:2px solid var(--band-s);padding-left:3px}

.sim-console .bandkey{flex:0 0 auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0;padding-top:2px;margin-top:2px;border-top:1px solid var(--edge2)}
.sim-console .brow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:8px 1fr auto;gap:4px;align-items:center;font-size:7.5px;white-space:nowrap}
.sim-console .brow i{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:1px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2)}
.sim-console .brow.l i{background:var(--band-l);box-shadow:0 0 5px rgba(111,182,255,.5)}
.sim-console .brow.m i{background:var(--band-m);box-shadow:0 0 5px rgba(230,209,82,.45)}
.sim-console .brow.s i{background:var(--band-s);box-shadow:0 0 5px rgba(111,224,138,.45)}
.sim-console .brow.l b{color:var(--band-l)}
.sim-console .brow.m b{color:var(--band-m)}
.sim-console .brow.s b{color:var(--band-s)}
.sim-console .brow b{font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.04em}
.sim-console .brow em{font-style:normal;font-size:6.5px;color:var(--ink-dim)}

.sim-console .legend{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0}
.sim-console .lrow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:8px 1fr auto;gap:4px;align-items:center;font-size:7.5px;padding:0}
.sim-console .sw{width:7px;height:7px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25);border-radius:1px}
.sim-console .sw.f{background:var(--blue);box-shadow:0 0 5px rgba(88,166,255,.5)}
.sim-console .sw.g{background:var(--grn);box-shadow:0 0 5px rgba(111,224,138,.45)}
.sim-console .sw.n{background:var(--amber);box-shadow:0 0 5px rgba(224,184,58,.45)}
.sim-console .sw.h{background:var(--red);box-shadow:0 0 5px rgba(224,85,74,.5)}
.sim-console .lrow b{font-weight:500;color:var(--ink-bright)}
.sim-console .lrow em{font-style:normal;font-size:6.5px;letter-spacing:.05em;color:var(--ink-dim);text-transform:uppercase}

.sim-console .footer{flex:0 0 auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;overflow:hidden}
.sim-console .decision{flex:0 0 auto}
.sim-console .decision>.bd{gap:1px;padding:1px 4px 2px}
/* workflow reminder: plain text, no button chrome \u2014 it is a caption, not a control */
.sim-console .seqhint{flex:0 0 auto;display:flex;flex-wrap:nowrap;gap:8px;font-size:7px;letter-spacing:.05em;color:var(--ink-dim);text-transform:uppercase;overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;padding:0 1px 1px}
.sim-console .seqhint u{text-decoration:none;border:0;padding:0;background:none}

/* ENGAGEMENT CONTROL: sized for the commit sequence in one row, with room for the round
   FIRE command. Compact type, no scroller. */
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"]{display:block;flex:0 0 auto;height:112px;padding:1px;overflow:hidden;font-size:8.5px;line-height:1.05;letter-spacing:.02em}
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] *{font-size:inherit;line-height:inherit;max-width:100%}
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] h1,.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] h2,.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] h3,.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] h4{font-size:8px;margin:0;letter-spacing:.07em}
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] svg{max-height:26px}
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] select,.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] input,.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] label,.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] a{font-family:inherit;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.03em;padding:1px 4px;line-height:1.1;min-height:0;min-width:0;border-radius:2px}
/* DEFAULT for every pressable thing the runtime injects here: real, legible button chrome. */
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button,
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] [role="button"]{font-family:inherit;font-size:9px!important;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:3px 8px!important;margin:1px;line-height:1.1;color:var(--ink-bright);background:linear-gradient(180deg,#12301d,#0a1a10);border:1px solid var(--edge);border-radius:2px;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(140,240,170,.10);cursor:pointer}
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[aria-pressed="true"],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button.active,
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button.selected,
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button.on{color:#04170a!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#8fe6a2,#4fae66)!important;border-color:#b6ffc8!important;box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(111,224,138,.35)}
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[disabled],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[aria-disabled="true"]{opacity:.45;cursor:default}

/* interceptor-band tinting, applied only if the runtime ever renders band controls here:
   long = blue, medium = yellow, short = green, so the three read apart at a glance. */
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[class*="long" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[value*="long" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[data-band*="long" i]{color:#eaf5ff!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#1b3c5c,#0b1d2e)!important;border-color:var(--band-l)!important}
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[class*="long" i][aria-pressed="true"],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[data-band*="long" i][aria-pressed="true"]{color:#04121f!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#9fd2ff,#4a8fd0)!important}
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[class*="medium" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[value*="medium" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[data-band*="med" i]{color:#fff6d2!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#4a3f12,#241d08)!important;border-color:var(--band-m)!important}
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[class*="medium" i][aria-pressed="true"],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[data-band*="med" i][aria-pressed="true"]{color:#1c1503!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f0dc72,#b79c2c)!important}
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[class*="short" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[value*="short" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[data-band*="short" i]{color:#e7ffee!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#123a20,#081a0e)!important;border-color:var(--band-s)!important}
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[class*="short" i][aria-pressed="true"],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[data-band*="short" i][aria-pressed="true"]{color:#04170a!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#8fe6a2,#3f9a58)!important}

/* FIRE / LAUNCH command: one round, red, unmistakable command on the console */
@keyframes simFireGlow{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(224,85,74,.7),0 0 0 3px rgba(224,85,74,.20),inset 0 2px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.28)}50%{box-shadow:0 0 34px rgba(255,110,90,1),0 0 0 5px rgba(224,85,74,.30),inset 0 2px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.34)}}
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button.fire,
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button.engage,
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button.btn-fire,
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button.danger,
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[class*="fire" i]:not([class*="cease" i]),
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[class*="engage" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[class*="shoot" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[class*="launch" i]:not([class*="launcher" i]),
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[id*="fire" i]:not([id*="cease" i]),
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[id*="engage" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[id*="launch" i]:not([id*="launcher" i]),
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[name*="fire" i]:not([name*="cease" i]),
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[value*="fire" i]:not([value*="cease" i]),
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[value*="launch" i]:not([value*="launcher" i]),
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[data-action*="fire" i]:not([data-action*="cease" i]),
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[data-action*="engage" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[data-action*="launch" i]:not([data-action*="launcher" i]),
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[data-role*="fire" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[aria-label*="fire" i]:not([aria-label*="cease" i]),
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[aria-label*="engage" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[aria-label*="launch" i]:not([aria-label*="launcher" i]),
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] [role="button"][class*="fire" i]:not([class*="cease" i]),
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] [role="button"][class*="engage" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] [role="button"][class*="launch" i]:not([class*="launcher" i]){display:inline-block!important;box-sizing:border-box!important;width:86px!important;height:86px!important;min-width:86px!important;padding:0 6px!important;margin:2px 6px!important;font-size:15px!important;font-weight:900!important;letter-spacing:.10em!important;text-transform:uppercase!important;text-align:center!important;white-space:normal!important;color:#fff2ee!important;background:radial-gradient(70% 70% at 50% 28%,#ff8b78 0%,#e2503f 48%,#8e1f17 100%)!important;border:3px solid #ff9c90!important;border-radius:50%!important;text-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.8);animation:simFireGlow 1.5s ease-in-out infinite;vertical-align:middle}
/* cease fire stays a subdued amber square so it cannot be mistaken for the round FIRE command */
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[class*="cease" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[id*="cease" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[data-action*="cease" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[value*="cease" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[aria-label*="cease" i]{width:auto!important;height:auto!important;border-radius:2px!important;font-size:9px!important;font-weight:600!important;padding:3px 9px!important;color:#f0dca0!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#3a2f10,#221a08)!important;border:1px solid #7a6420!important;box-shadow:none!important;animation:none!important;text-shadow:none;letter-spacing:.08em}
/* if reload / magazine commands are ever switched on in the profile, they land here already dressed */
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[class*="reload" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[class*="rearm" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[class*="magazine" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[data-action*="reload" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[data-action*="magazine" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[aria-label*="reload" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[aria-label*="magazine" i]{width:auto!important;height:auto!important;border-radius:2px!important;font-size:11px!important;font-weight:800!important;letter-spacing:.10em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:4px 12px!important;color:#04170a!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#8fe6a2,#3f9a58)!important;border:1px solid #b6ffc8!important;box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(111,224,138,.3)!important;animation:none!important;text-shadow:none}
/* the same hooks inside the resources panel, so anything rendered there reads alike */
.sim-console [data-slot="resources"] button,.sim-console [data-slot="resources"] [role="button"],.sim-console [data-slot="resources"] select{font-family:inherit;font-size:8.5px!important;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:2px 6px;margin:1px 0;border-radius:2px;color:var(--ink-bright);background:linear-gradient(180deg,#12301d,#0a1a10);border:1px solid var(--edge);cursor:pointer}
.sim-console [data-slot="resources"] button[aria-pressed="true"],.sim-console [data-slot="resources"] button.active,.sim-console [data-slot="resources"] button.selected{color:#04170a!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#8fe6a2,#4fae66)!important;border-color:#b6ffc8!important}

.sim-console .keyrow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:6px;align-items:center;overflow:hidden}
.sim-console .fkeys{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(12,minmax(0,1fr));gap:3px}
.sim-console .fkey{padding:0;text-align:center;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.04em;border:1px solid var(--edge2);border-radius:2px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0e2415,#081209);color:var(--ink-dim);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(120,220,150,.06)}
.sim-console .fkey.act{color:#04170a;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#8fe6a2,#4fae66);border-color:#8fe6a2}
.sim-console .fkey.off{color:#27452f;border-color:#152b1b}
.sim-console .plate{padding:0 10px;border:1px solid #4a3f1e;border-radius:2px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#3a3117,#221c0d);color:#c9b26a;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;white-space:nowrap}

@media (max-width:1460px){
.sim-console .main{grid-template-columns:66px minmax(0,1fr) 226px;grid-template-rows:minmax(0,2fr) minmax(0,1fr);grid-template-areas:"rail scope res" "rail picture res"}
}
@media (max-width:1080px){
.sim-console .main{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 132px;grid-template-rows:minmax(0,2fr) minmax(0,1fr);grid-template-areas:"scope res" "picture res"}
.sim-console .rail{display:none}
}
@media (max-height:760px){
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"]{height:104px}
}
@media (max-height:660px){
.sim-console .footer .keyrow{display:none}
.sim-console .seqhint{display:none}
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"]{height:98px}
}

result.design_notes: On the reload and magazine-selection buttons (requests 6, 7, 8 and now the colour-coded ammunition buttons in 9): I cannot draw them, and a painted dead button is worse than none. This profile's operator_commands has reload switched off — turn on 'Reload during a run' under 'What the operator can do' and give it the seconds it really takes, and the simulator will render a working reload button into the decision area, which my CSS already dresses. Launcher choice is likewise switched off ('launchers': false). Choosing the interceptor band is not on the command list at all — the profile lists interceptor type and launcher as things the system recommends automatically — so there is nothing for a short/medium/long button to do; instead I colour-keyed the three bands as readouts (long = blue #6fb6ff, medium = yellow #e6d152, short = green #6fe08a) in the Magazines panel and added matching tints that will apply automatically if band controls are ever switched on. The '8 rounds' you hit is the simulator's default: magazine_depth is empty in the profile, so fill in the real total on the behaviour screen. What did change this time: the FIRE / LAUNCH command injected into the decision slot is now a large round red button (86 px disc, radial red fill, 3 px light-red rim, pulsing glow), CEASE FIRE stays a small subdued amber rectangle so the two can never be confused, the band colour key was added, and the misleading 'reload magazine' step was dropped from the workflow caption. Everything else is unchanged from the previous revision: green-on-black CRT palette sampled from the screenshots (#0a150e panels, #2f6b3f hairline borders, #8ee39a ink, #c9ffd4 headings, amber clock), the rail / scope / track-readout / magazine four-column body with the fixed-pixel side columns that anchor the radar port against growing message text, the wide engagement strip and the F1–F12 key row and brass plate as fixed chrome.
